jezero_crater.name: Jezero Crater
jezero_crater.coordinate_source: Mars 2020 landing ellipse center — Golombek et al. 2020; widely cited in literature. Approximate.
cannot_reproduce: Gravity: 0.38 g (3.72 m/s²) — no terrestrial equivalent
Atmosphere: 0.6 kPa, 95% CO₂; no breathable air; partial pressure too low for liquid water at the surface
UV and ionizing radiation: no ozone layer; UV and ionizing radiation at surface exceeds any habitable Earth surface
Global dust storms: planetary-scale events lasting months with severe irradiance loss — no terrestrial equivalent at planetary scale
Absolute temperatures: −140 °C (polar night) to +20 °C (equatorial afternoon); annual and diurnal range exceeds any Earth surface location
Perchlorates in regolith: no terrestrial surface-level analog
Dust: fine-grained (<10 µm) globally mobile dust; settling behavior fundamentally different from Earth owing to low gravity and thin atmosphere

slope.source: MOLA MEGDR Jezero crater floor — Golombek et al. 2020 (doi:10.1029/2020EA001152): slope 0.5–2° at 1 km scale; midpoint used. UNVERIFIED.

roughness.source: MOLA MEGDR — Jezero floor roughness; Golombek et al. 2020 reports rock abundance and roughness within acceptable range; rough estimate 5–15 m. UNVERIFIED.
